name: Atlantis (STS-44)
about: Atlantis (STS-44) (1991-080A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1991 Nov 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1991 Nov 26), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW05R); its coordinates are written from memory
